title: Relative spectrum morphism chart compatibility
statement: Let S be a scheme, E the affine relative-spectrum equivalence, and hobj the object identifications with pushforward structure algebras. For every algebra morphism φ and affine open U, the induced affine morphism chart commutes with Spec.map of the section map.

proof.text: Apply naturality of the counit of the equivalence to φ. Rewrite the resulting sectionwise equality using the object identifications hobj and the formula for the canonical functor on morphisms. The affine toSpecΓ naturality lemma and functoriality of Spec.map yield exactly the displayed chart equality.
